description: Tech opening and internal transitions: Main handoff, retained help fades, single-column and two-column paging, shortcut/header returns, forget confirmation and unavailable-forget notices.
registration: Reuses the unchanged tech-lists-paired-v3 Dolphin capture and tech-lists-fixture-v1 source/native technique grants. Native update 64 is source VI zero, with the complete actor, animation, effect, RNG, background-wait, save-spark and skit origin copied from the shared school checkpoint. All 5,510 memory observations satisfy UI clock = 38084 + VI and effect clock = 37551 + VI, so there are no omitted loading waits or presentation/effect advances. Y first takes effect at source VI 12; all later source inputs first take effect at poll/2 + 1 and map to native update VI + 64. Native inputs are one-update action edges with no held repeats. Tech initializes at VI 183 with page fade 206, reaches fade 0 at VI 192, and changes the retained description at VI 198. The original 35 settled Tech captures are retained alongside transition frames. Full images, party state and effect clock, and Tech navigation/transition state from VI 183 are compared at the existing 8/1% tolerance. This older capture contains no effect random-state observation, so effect_clock_state checks only the recorded clock. It also lacks equipment/save-point observations, so tech_navigation_state covers focus, scrolling, page/help/banner/popup phases and selected owner without claiming loadout state. It contains no Main state words, so Main opening/handoff is image-checked without a main_menu_state gate. Its route never closes/reopens Tech or produces a nonzero row-scroll offset; those cases require a later source recording. Source video timestamps omit VI 2745, which is excluded; all other selected VIs are present. No source-only timing or animation origins are fabricated.
